title: Kamisama Kiss
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Left homeless when her father skips town over gambling debts, high schooler Nanami Momozono accepts a stranger's offer of his home and finds she has become the land god of a shrine (to verify). Bound by a kiss to the fox spirit Tomoe, his familiar, she learns to serve as a god among youkai and deities while their prickly bond turns to romance (to verify).
life_message: It holds up kindness, persistence and loyal love as the way to find a home and belong.

content.note: Fantasy fights with youkai and curses (to verify).
Demons, curses and Tomoe's dark past (to verify; AniList Demons).
Kisses bind familiars; central human-youkai romance with a centuries-old fox (to verify; AniList Monster Boy).
Youkai and gods drink sake at festivals (to verify).
Nanami's abandonment and homelessness at the start (to verify).
